channel.allowFromEmpty: Inka users add cheyyaledu — evaraina bot tho interact avvachu.
channel.allowFromHint: Listed users matrame bot tho interact avvachu; mee 'Platform User ID' auto-ga include avtundi.
channel.appSecretHint: App Secret yokka mee bot app. Idi will be encrypted mariyu stored securely.
channel.appSecretPlaceholder: Mee app secret ikkada paste cheyyandi
channel.applicationIdHint: Unique identifier kosam mee bot app.
channel.botTokenEncryptedHint: Token will be encrypted mariyu stored securely.
channel.charLimitHint: Maximum number yokka characters per message
channel.concurrencyDebounceHint: Only process last message lo a burst (earlier ones unnaru dropped)
channel.concurrencyQueueHint: Process messages one at a time
channel.connectQueued: Bot connection queued. Idi will start cheyyi shortly.
channel.connectStarting: Bot undi starting. Dayachesi wait a moment.
channel.connectionModeHint: How platform delivers events ki bot
channel.connectionModeWebhookHint: Vaadandi aithe mee bot undi a callback URL configured
channel.debounceMsHint: How long ki wait kosam additional messages before dispatching ki agent (ms)
channel.deleteAllConfirm: Unnaru meeru sure meeru kavali ki teeseyi anni channels?
channel.deleteAllConfirmDesc: Ee action will permanently teeseyi anni message channels mariyu their configurations kosam ee agent. Ee cannot be undone.
channel.deleteConfirm: Unnaru meeru sure meeru kavali ki teeseyi ee channel?
channel.deleteConfirmDesc: Ee action will permanently teeseyi ee message channel mariyu its configuration. Ee cannot be undone.
channel.devWebhookProxyUrlHint: Optional. HTTPS tunnel URL kosam forwarding webhook requests ki local dev server.
channel.discord.description: Connect ee assistant ki Discord server kosam channel chat mariyu direct messages.
channel.displayToolCallsHint: Chupinchu tool call vivaralu time lo AI responses. When disable ayindi, only final response undi displayed kosam a cleaner experience.
channel.dmPolicyAllowlistHint: Only listed users can DM bot
channel.encryptKeyHint: Optional. Vaadina ki decrypt encrypted event payloads.
channel.endpointUrlHint: Dayachesi copy cheyyi ee URL mariyu paste idi loki<bold>{{fieldName}}</bold>field lo{{name}}Developer Portal.
channel.groupAllowFromEmpty: Ledu channels added yet — bot will kadu respond anywhere.
channel.groupAllowFromHint: Channel / group / chat IDs bot may respond lo.
channel.groupPolicyHint: Where bot responds lo groups, channels, mariyu threads
channel.groupPolicyOpenHint: Respond lo ye group, channel, leka thread
channel.historyLimitHint: Default number yokka messages ki fetch when reading channel charitra
channel.line.channelAccessTokenHint: Long-lived token issued under Messaging API tab. Token will be encrypted mariyu stored securely.
channel.line.channelSecretHint: Nundi Basic settings tab. Avasaram — vaadina ki verify X-Line-Signature on prathi inbound webhook.
channel.line.description: Connect ee assistant ki LINE Messaging API kosam direct mariyu group chats.
channel.line.destinationUserIdHint: bot's own user ID (`U`+ 32 chars) — click cheyyi "Fetch nundi LINE" below ki auto-fill. Kadu personal "Mee user ID" shown lo LINE's Basic settings.
channel.line.fetchBotInfoMissingToken: Enter cheyyi Channel Access Token mundu, then click cheyyi "Fetch nundi LINE".
channel.line.webhookManualSetup: LINE does kadu allow programmatic webhook registration. Copy cheyyi ee URL loki LINE Developers Console (Messaging API → Webhook URL), click cheyyi "Verify", mariyu enable "Vaadandi webhook".
channel.messengerPromo.desc: Ledu bot setup. Chat tho ChinnaHub on Slack, Discord, Telegram.
channel.messengerPromo.title: Skip setup
channel.publicKeyHint: Optional. Vaadina ki verify interaction requests nundi Discord.
channel.secretTokenHint: Optional. Vaadina ki verify webhook requests nundi Telegram.
channel.serverIdHint: Default server / guild AI tools act on; kadu vaadina kosam access control
channel.serverIdHint.discord: Enable cheyyi Developer Mode (Settings → Advanced), then right-click server icon → Copy cheyyi Server ID.
channel.serverIdHint.slack: Workspace ID (starts tho T). Find idi under Settings & administration → Workspace settings, leka lo workspace URL.
channel.settingsResetConfirm: Unnaru meeru sure meeru kavali ki reset advanced settings ki default?
channel.showUsageStatsHint: Chupinchu token usage, cost, mariyu duration stats lo bot replies
channel.slack.appIdHint: Mee Slack App ID nundi Slack API dashboard (starts tho A).
channel.slack.appTokenHint: Avasaram kosam Socket Mode (WebSocket). Generate an app-level token (xapp-...) under Basic Information lo mee Slack app settings.
channel.slack.description: Connect ee assistant ki Slack kosam channel conversations mariyu direct messages.
channel.slack.webhookMigrationDesc: Socket Mode provides real-time event delivery via WebSocket lekunda exposing a public HTTP endpoint. Ki migrate, enable Socket Mode lo mee Slack app settings, generate an App-Level Token, then switch Connection Mode ki WebSocket lo Advanced Settings.
channel.telegram.description: Connect ee assistant ki Telegram kosam private mariyu group chats.
channel.userIdHint: Lets AI tools reach meeru proactively (e.g. reminders); auto-trusted dvara global allowlist
channel.userIdHint.discord: Enable cheyyi Developer Mode (Settings → Advanced), then right-click mee avatar → Copy cheyyi User ID.
channel.userIdHint.line: Open cheyyi LINE Developers Console → mee channel → Basic settings tab, mariyu copy cheyyi "Mee user ID" (starts tho U, 33 chars).
channel.userIdHint.slack: Open cheyyi mee Slack profile → ⋮ Inka → Copy cheyyi member ID (starts tho U).
channel.userIdHint.telegram: Send ye message ki @userinfobot lo Telegram — idi replies tho mee numeric User ID.
channel.userIdMissingDesc: Lekunda idi, AI tools can't reach meeru tho reminders, mariyu pairing approvals will fail. Fill idi lo under Advanced Settings.
channel.userIdMissingTitle: Add cheyyi mee platform User ID
channel.validationError: Dayachesi fill lo App ID mariyu Token
channel.verificationTokenHint: Optional. Vaadina ki verify webhook event source.
channel.wechat.description: Connect ee assistant ki WeChat via iLink Bot kosam private mariyu group chats.
channel.wechatBotIdHint: Bot identifier assigned taruvata QR code authorization.
channel.wechatIdleNotice: Aithe ledu users send messages kosam over 7 days, ee connection will be automatically paused. Ki resume, click cheyyi "Rebind via QR Code".
channel.wechatManagedCredentials: Ee channel undi ippatike connect ayyi through QR code authorization. Credentials unnaru managed automatically.
channel.wechatQrExpired: QR code expired. Dayachesi refresh ki pondi a new one.
channel.wechatQrScaned: QR code scanned. Dayachesi confirm login lo WeChat.
channel.wechatQrWait: Open cheyyi WeChat mariyu scan QR code ki connect.
channel.wechatTips: Dayachesi update cheyyi WeChat ki latest version mariyu restart idi. ClawBot plugin undi lo gradual rollout, so check Settings > Plugins ki confirm access.
channel.wechatUserIdHint: WeChat akhount identifier returned dvara authorization flow.
